response.text: Remaining checks: journal 2271 (the 5900 line, which breaks the pattern of one expense plus AP), GL journals from unusual users, and the payment journal for invoice 509.

arguments.sql: select h."JRNL_NO", h."SRC_REF", h."MEMO", h."POST_DT", i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT" from "GLJRNH" h left join "APINVH" i on i."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" where h."JRNL_NO" in (1941,2271)

select h."JRNL_NO", h."SRC_REF", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD", l."DR_AMT", l."CR_AMT" from "GLJRNH" h join "GLJRNL" l using ("JRNL_NO") where h."SRC_REF" in ('PAY-'||(select "PAY_ID" from "APPAYM" where "INV_ID"=509)) or h."JRNL_NO" in (1832)
select h."SRC_REF", count(*), sum(l."DR_AMT") from "GLJRNH" h join "GLJRNL" l using ("JRNL_NO") where h."SRC_CD"='GL' group by 1
